research.finding: Reduced shoot growth and leaf size are useful nutrition cues; exact symptoms and colour depend on deficiency.
Colour should be accompanied by another visible distinction; use ordered size/fullness and posture here.

colour_interpretation: Semantic map legend colours, not a claim that all nutrient-starved plants turn red.
normalization: Fixed soil width and bottom ground line. Increasing foliage size is retained; do not fit each icon to identical overall bounds.
